output.summary: Turnover rise is real: HR counts match payroll records, so the PeopleCore artifact claim fails. Cedar Hollow rose about 19 points against a peer median rise of about 5, so local labor-market conditions alone do not explain it. Separations were already elevated Oct-Feb and stepped up in March, right after the 2026-03-02 Saturday policy and before the ShiftWise go-live. Monthly separations did not change after go-live, and exit-survey respondents were split in proportion to ShiftWise's share of tellers. Pay was cited at similar rates in both years, and current market position is unknown. Manager attribution relies on a stale PeopleCore manager field. Overtime is explained by open requisitions. Recommend by-branch analysis, a pay benchmark and a ShiftWise hold. Do not approve the 15% raise or the bonus withholding now.
